bracket.meaning: any real deadhead model lies between the bound that forbids every cross-terminal connection and the relaxation that grants them all for free. dilworth_cross_check.why_it_must_hold: under zero deadhead the reachability relation is transitively closed, so minimum chain cover = maximum antichain (Dilworth) = peak interval concurrency.
